## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?
e.g. "As a circle organizer, I can't currently set a custom penalty rate."

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you considered and why you ruled them out.

## Affected Component

- [ ] `contracts/circle`
- [ ] `contracts/circle_factory`
- [ ] `contracts/reputation`
- [ ] `sdk`
- [ ] `indexer`
- [ ] `app`
- [ ] `scripts`
- [ ] Documentation

## Additional Context

Any mockups, links, or references that would help explain the feature.
